jobs.title: 2027 Summer Investment Internship
jobs.description:
Who we are:

Battery is a private equity and venture capital firm with over 40 years of heritage investing in category-leading technology companies. With offices in Boston, San Francisco, Menlo Park, New York City, Tel Aviv, and London, the firm manages over $16B of invested capital and is currently investing its 15th fund of $3.25B. We are seeking exceptional juniors (class of 2028) to join our Investment Team as full-time summer interns in our Boston office in Summer 2027.

Description of internship :

Summer interns will focus primarily on our buyout strategy and will gain exposure to multiple stages of the investment process.

Short-term and long-term project work will include market and product analysis, sourcing new investment opportunities, presenting to investment team members, and learning aspects of a full-time Analyst role.

Each intern will be paired with a mentor for the course of the program. The program will start in early June and will wrap up in mid-August.

Our hope is that high-performing candidates will transition to a full-time analyst position in Boston for the following fall.

Qualifications :

- Excellent academic record at a leading college/university

- Investing experience in venture capital, growth equity, private equity, or investment banking is a plus

- A quick study with a demonstrated ability to rapidly build fluency in new subject areas and synthesize complex information into key insights

- Would be characterized by references as a self-starter, team player, and hard worker with a hunger and willingness to learn

- Strong interest in technology-related investing and a long-term investing role with room for growth

- Outgoing, sales-oriented personality and ability to engage in meaningful dialogue with technology executives

Expected pay:

9,200 USD per month
